title: 3x2 six-view turnaround sheet of one piece (wearer's axes, identical scale)
description: Moodboard P8 (sheet): a turnaround sheet for each piece in turn, starting with the Helmet, laid out like the attached example sheet (the Sandal sheet).

body.subject: A turnaround sheet of the {{asset_name}}, similar to the attached example turnaround sheet (the Sandal sheet), one per piece, starting with the Helmet. Match the reference of the piece exactly for proportion, materials, wear and detail.
body.action: LAYOUT: a 3x2 grid, six cells, in this exact order. Top row, left to right: FRONT, RIGHT, BACK. Bottom row, left to right: LEFT, TOP, BOTTOM. Even gutters between cells. Each view centred in its own cell. No cell merged, no view repeated, no extra views, no hero shot.
body.camera: VIEW DEFINITIONS (axes are the WEARER's, not the object's): FRONT from directly in front of the wearer, looking at their chest; RIGHT from the wearer's own right side; BACK from directly behind the wearer; LEFT from the wearer's own left side; TOP from directly above, looking down; BOTTOM from directly below, looking up. SCALE (the single most important requirement): All six views rendered at IDENTICAL scale, as if one object photographed six times by a camera moved around it. Do not resize any view to fill its cell. A shorter view must leave more empty space, not be enlarged. Orthographic projection. No perspective distortion.
body.style: PRESENTATION (follow exactly): Flat solid background, pure magenta #FF00FF, edge to edge, including the gutters. No gradient, no vignette, no checkerboard, no drawn transparency pattern, no panel borders, no dividing lines. Flat, even, diffuse lighting from the camera direction, IDENTICAL in every cell. No cast shadow, no contact shadow, no ground plane, no rim light. Minimal specular highlight. Matte material response.
body.constraints: No text, no labels, no captions, no view names, no watermark, no props, no set dressing, no hands, no mannequin, no other pieces. Landscape 3:2 aspect ratio. Highest resolution available.
